_note: IDENTIFIED automated-traffic events, declared with their evidence so every analysis excludes the SAME periods. Read only through lib/bot-traffic.js. This is a HAND-REVIEWED record, never a heuristic: the site's real paid-giveaway campaign (2026-08-19 -> 08-29) ran at 3.5x-15x the median day, so any rule keyed on volume alone would discard a real campaign. An event belongs here only when something other than its size identifies it.
_ga4_timezone: America/Los_Angeles — a GA4 snapshot day is a PACIFIC day, which is why the 2026-09-15 UTC wave lands on the 2026-09-14 GA4 file. Convert before adding ga4_days.
_fail_open: A missing, unreadable or empty file excludes NOTHING and every consumer says so. Losing real data to a bad exclusion is worse than leaving a known bot day in.

events.what: The automated entry wave that took 40% of the giveaway entrant pool. 2,948 entries were disqualified under Official Rules §5.
evidence: 5,920 of 5,930 entry requests on ONE user-agent string across 2,792 distinct IPs, against 70 distinct agents over the preceding five days.
GA4 2026-09-14: 3,380 sessions against a 123-session 90-day median (27.5x), of which 3,150 are (direct)/(none) and 3,145 landed on /pages/free-soap-giveaway.
96% desktop against a 57% normal median, and a 5.7% bounce rate against a 26.8% median — no real cohort looks like that.
events.not_excluded_because_of_size: The size is corroboration, not the identifier. The identifier is the single-UA/2,792-IP fan-out in the entry logs plus the 96%-desktop, 5.7%-bounce, single-landing-page signature.

events.what: A sweep of every product page and the top blog post, from a residential-proxy pool.
evidence: 339 distinct IPs sending EXACTLY 2 requests each (13 sent 1), all sharing one Chrome/145 macOS user agent.
686 RUM beacons in a single UTC hour from one viewport (1366px), against a 19-beacon site-wide median hour.
TTFB p50 2,455ms against 500-850ms for real visitors.
events.ga4_days_empty_because: GA4 snapshots only run through 2026-09-16 at the time this was written, and nothing in the 90-day GA4 series crossed 3x the median on 09-17. Add a day here only if a snapshot later shows it.
events.not_excluded_because_of_size: 1,000 beacons is an ordinary busy day here. The identifier is the exactly-2-per-IP uniformity across 339 IPs.
